mods.name: Maple
mods.description: Maple is a free and powerful path-finding bot that lets you navigate the vast landscapes of Minecraft without any user intervention.

releases.notes:
This is the first major release of Maple, created from the first 4 months of the development process.

### Changelog:

- Added MLGs to the move set of Maple
- Added an improved version of the parkour movement
- Added costs for walking in cobwebs and berry bushes
- Added additional costs for breaking blocks under falling blocks (e.g. gravel, sand, ...)
- Added control over the entire inventory
- Added bubble column avoidance
- Added ability to open doors, trapdoors and fence gates
- Added ability to walk up stairs and slabs
- Added ascending parkour jumps
- Added task system
    - Removed goal, go and axis command
    - Added pause and resume commands
    - Added mine, farm and follow commands
    - Added goto <block_type> command
- Added thisway and tunnel commands
